:::{#exm-cohen-kappa-covid}
#### Cohen's kappa for the COVID-19 test

For the COVID-19 test of @exm-sensitivity and @exm-specificity
in the [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population) of @exm-prevalence,
the [overall agreement](#def-overall-agreement) is $p_o = 0.99$ (@exm-overall-agreement)
and the [chance agreement](#def-chance-agreement) is $p_e = 0.862404$ (@exm-chance-agreement),
so [Cohen's kappa](#def-cohen-kappa) is:

$$
\ba
\kappa
&= \frac{0.99 - 0.862404}{1 - 0.862404}
&& \text{(definition of } \kappa \text{)} \\
&= \frac{0.127596}{1 - 0.862404}
&& \text{(subtract in the numerator)} \\
&= \frac{0.127596}{0.137596}
&& \text{(subtract in the denominator)} \\
&\approx 0.927
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-cohen-kappa}

:::
